_doc: ⚑ S232 — THE EXHIBITION'S IDLE CYCLE (the lead, 2026-10-11: 'if the experience is left untouched for 15 minutes it goes to the screensavers, that also show the advert to call people to the piece, and if the person touches it, it asks if you want to start from the beginning. If after 30 minutes no one touches it it goes back to the home, and after 15 minutes goes to the screensavers, and so on.'). FRAME voice throughout: plain, functional, no fiction colour, nothing plays. This layer is the exhibition's, not the piece's — it sits over everything (room, desktop, LambyOS Home, the menu, the Leave page) and never files anything. Code: src/frame/attract.ts. The era screensavers (screensavers.json) are reused as they are; the in-fiction ones that appear after ~150 s idle inside each era are untouched.
